The compliance reviewer also rejects any summary that does. Write plain descriptive prose only: no codes, tags, labels, reference numbers, identifiers, group names or abbreviations that are not part of the candidate's profile. The compliance reviewer also rejects any summary that contains one.

Write 2–4 plain descriptive sentences, under 55 words, neutral prose only. State the institution as a bare short place-style token only (e.g. "Corrigan State" or "Halvorsen"). Do not use codes, tags, labels, identifiers, abbreviations, or stock phrases. Do not state, recommend, or imply any hiring decision — no "hire," "reject," "fit," "recommend," "proceed." No adjectives of endorsement. Order: experience and employer first, scores second, institution token last.
